profile: nonlinear model: An array of nonlinear models can be trained and validated, with the hope that a more complex rule might better distinguish between cats and dogs. More generally, a general nonlinear model for regression and two-class classification is a weighted sum of B nonlinear functions: model(x, Θ) = w0 + f1(x)w1 + ... + fB(x)wB.
